tools.name: checktopus_authenticate
tools.description: Authenticate with a Checktopus App-bound install/device token. Returns the bound App id.

token.description: Install token (optional if CHECKTOPUS_INSTALL_TOKEN is set)

tools.name: checktopus_fetch_job
tools.description: Fetch the current Content-Check Job (scope/hints/Binding expectations) and Inventory contract version for the bound App. Does not expose the full rule engine.

tools.name: checktopus_collect_inventory
tools.description: Collect conforming static-text Inventory from a local App tree inside this MCP process (deterministic Collector; no LLM; no Control Plane filesystem access). Returns inventory + collectorAttestation to forward on submit. Do not invent Inventory via ad-hoc string search.

appTreePath.description: Local App tree path (absolute or relative to the MCP process cwd; resolved with realpath). Prefer this over inventing Inventory via ad-hoc search.

expectedContractVersion.description: Optional Job inventoryContract.version; mismatch fails closed (no silent alternate contract).

tools.name: checktopus_submit_evidence
tools.description: Submit conforming Inventory + HEAD/Binding history-check attestation + LLM Signals (including model id). Cloud Gate evaluates under the TEMPORARY first-slice Objectionable profile; temporary pass is not store-ready clearance. Optional runStatus=aborted or missingPlanes block the Gate. Pass assessmentMode and collectorAttestation for sample vs full Gate paths. Forward collectorAttestation from checktopus_collect_inventory — do not invent attestation fields.

assessmentMode.description: Assessment Mode: full (default) or sample. Locked for the Job after first submit.

collectorAttestation.description: Collector Attestation (inventoryDigest must match submitted Inventory). Required for temporary full-mode pass.

tools.name: checktopus_confirm_binding
tools.description: Confirm local App repo identity (absolute path, remotes, branch, short SHA) then write Binding Commit via agent Binding Confirm. Call once without approve to preview; call again with approve=true to bind. Multi-Root requires selectedRoot. Does not bind silently.

selectedRoot.description: Required when multiple workspaceRoots are present — which App repo to bind

approve.description: Must be true to write Binding Commit after reviewing identity fields. Omit/false for preview only.
